summary: Helicopter crews behind clear cockpits and a faint rotor disc in flight; wheel arches on 8x8s; crew kit and rolled tarps on roofs and cabs; tarps that take the shape of the boxes under them; louvred, perforated and meshed engine decks; a remodelled SUV, MB 4WD, quad bike and kart; and a cost pass that leaves the roster lighter.
rationale: Glass, geometry, cloth and colour changes across many families: one matched studio sheet shows a representative of each, framed close where the change is small.
